title: Easy to Tip Over
text: Easy to Tip Over. This was quick and easy to assemble. Out of the box, it only took a few minutes for my husband to put it all together. The issue I have had with it is that the baskets can get knocked out of it a little to easily. My cat bunted the lower basket and one of the sides fell out its notch. It was easy to put back in place though.  It also doesn't have a very large weight capacity. If you put items in the top basket and nothing in the lower ones, it tips over. The handle is merely for decoration. If you pull on it, it falls apart. It doesn't push well either. It looks good and if you find the right spot for it, I think it can be a decent storage unit.
